description: Get recent Discord bot console log lines. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

lines.description: Number of recent log lines to return, 1-200 (default 50). Values above 200 are rejected.

serviceId.description: ID of the Discord bot: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_discord_bots (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: get_discord_bot_console_logs
title: Get Discord Bot Console Logs
